checks.title: Ensure SSH Protocol is set to 2
checks.remediation:
Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config. Set: Protocol 2
Then run: sudo systemctl restart sshd

checks.title: Ensure SSH MaxAuthTries is set to 4 or less
checks.remediation:
Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config. Set: MaxAuthTries 4
Then run: sudo systemctl restart sshd

checks.title: Ensure SSH IgnoreRhosts is enabled
checks.remediation:
Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config. Set: IgnoreRhosts yes
Then run: sudo systemctl restart sshd

checks.title: Ensure SSH HostbasedAuthentication is disabled
checks.remediation:
Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config. Set: HostbasedAuthentication no
Then run: sudo systemctl restart sshd

checks.title: Ensure SSH PermitRootLogin is disabled
checks.remediation:
Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config. Set: PermitRootLogin no
Then run: sudo systemctl restart sshd

checks.title: Ensure SSH PermitEmptyPasswords is disabled
checks.remediation:
Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config. Set: PermitEmptyPasswords no
Then run: sudo systemctl restart sshd

checks.title: Ensure SSH PermitUserEnvironment is disabled
checks.remediation:
Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config. Set: PermitUserEnvironment no
Then run: sudo systemctl restart sshd

checks.title: Ensure SSH X11Forwarding is disabled
checks.remediation:
Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config. Set: X11Forwarding no
Then run: sudo systemctl restart sshd

checks.title: Ensure SSH MaxStartups is configured
checks.remediation:
Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config. Set: MaxStartups 10:30:60
Then run: sudo systemctl restart sshd

checks.title: Ensure SSH MaxSessions is set to 10 or less
checks.remediation:
Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config. Set: MaxSessions 10
Then run: sudo systemctl restart sshd

checks.title: Ensure SSH LoginGraceTime is set to one minute or less
checks.remediation:
Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config. Set: LoginGraceTime 60
Then run: sudo systemctl restart sshd

checks.title: Ensure SSH Banner is configured
checks.remediation:
Create /etc/ssh/banner.txt with login banner.
Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config. Set: Banner /etc/ssh/banner.txt
Then run: sudo systemctl restart sshd

checks.title: Ensure SSH access is limited
checks.remediation: Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config. Configure: AllowUsers or AllowGroups

checks.title: Ensure SSH LogLevel is appropriate
checks.remediation: Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config. Set: LogLevel VERBOSE

checks.title: Ensure IP forwarding is disabled
checks.remediation: Set kernel parameter: net.ipv4.ip_forward = 0

checks.title: Ensure ICMP redirects are not accepted
checks.remediation: Set kernel parameters to disable ICMP redirects

checks.title: Ensure TCP SYN Cookies is enabled
checks.remediation: Set kernel parameter: net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies = 1

checks.title: Ensure mounting of cramfs filesystems is disabled
checks.remediation: Run: echo 'install cramfs /bin/true' | sudo tee -a /etc/modprobe.d/cramfs.conf

checks.title: Ensure password expiration is 365 days or less
checks.remediation: Edit /etc/login.defs. Set: PASS_MAX_DAYS 365

checks.title: Ensure password creation requirements are configured
checks.remediation: Edit /etc/security/pwquality.conf. Configure password complexity requirements.

checks.title: Ensure sudo is installed
checks.remediation: Install sudo: sudo apt install sudo

checks.title: Ensure sudo commands use pty
checks.remediation: Add to /etc/sudoers: Defaults use_pty

checks.title: Ensure sudo log file exists
checks.remediation: Add to /etc/sudoers: Defaults logfile='/var/log/sudo.log'

checks.title: Ensure ufw is installed
checks.remediation: Install ufw: sudo apt install ufw

checks.title: Ensure ufw service is enabled
checks.remediation: Enable and start ufw: sudo systemctl enable ufw && sudo systemctl start ufw

checks.title: Ensure default deny firewall policy
checks.remediation: Configure firewall defaults: sudo ufw default deny incoming && sudo ufw default allow outgoing

checks.title: Ensure xinetd is not installed
checks.remediation: Remove xinetd: sudo apt purge xinetd

checks.title: Ensure X11 Server is not installed
checks.remediation: Remove X11: sudo apt purge xserver-xorg-*
